name: Owner retains turn for execution
goal: When an EXECUTE message names the sender as Owner and the peer as Reviewer, the relay must not hand the turn to the reviewer and create an acknowledgement loop.

workspace_files.README.md:
# Owner Routing Trap

The implementation owner must edit result.txt before asking for review.

context: Codex is the implementation owner. It must edit result.txt to contain OWNER-ROUTING-PASS, then post results to Claude for review. Claude should review the concrete result, not acknowledge a promise to work. The mailbox must not bounce between acknowledgement messages.
